producer_report.summary:
I wrote the design in docs/design/structure-pass.md, added D138 (proposed) to docs/decisions.md, and added a CHANGELOG line. Only those three files changed (checked with git status); I changed no code and ran no cargo checks.

**The plan:**
- **`gh.rs`:** it becomes a `gh/` directory with `transport`, `host`, `remote`, `pages`, `records`, `early` and `landing` modules.
- **`run.rs`:** it becomes a `run/` directory with `planning`, `pin`, `send_back`, `producer`, `candidate`, `checks`, `verification` and `close`.
- **`produce_and_verify`:** the doc splits it into ten stages (S1–S10) along the stage comments already in the function.
- **Re-exports:** each `mod.rs` re-exports every public item at its old path, so callers don't change.
- **Jobs:** there are 18 single-producer jobs (G1–G8, R0–R9). Leaf modules come first. The caller-heavy ones come last: the host client, landing, close-and-land, and the `produce_and_verify` split.
- **Proof per move:** same tests with only `use` lines edited, same `cargo test -- --list` output, moved text matching under `git diff --color-moved`, nothing changed outside the two directories, clean fmt and clippy, and a grep of every old path with equal counts before and after.

**Needs Sri's approval:** two files name the path `gh.rs`, so G1 can't be a pure rename. `crates/athena-core/tests/external_calls_guard.rs` allows `Command::new("gh")` only at that exact path. `crates/athena-core/src/introspect.rs` lists it in the decision headers D87 and D88. Editing the guard test goes beyond "imports only". The doc asks Sri to approve it, and offers an alternative that keeps a small `gh.rs` in place.

**Re-measured counts:** `gh.rs` is 5,478 lines now (the request said 5,276) and `run.rs` is 3,164. I found four `run.rs` functions over 180 lines besides `produce_and_verify`, not five. Production line counts are my estimates from line ranges, and I didn't re-count the 251 functions.

mistakes: The first draft stated several caller facts (which files build GhClient, who uses PagesHost) without checking them. I replaced them with Grep results, and one remaining claim about PagesHost users is still hedged for the job to re-grep.
The 10 landings in the last week come from the request and were not measured.
learnings: crates/athena-core/tests/external_calls_guard.rs hard-codes crates/athena-core/src/gh.rs as the one file allowed to run gh, so renaming gh.rs fails that test.

crates/athena-core/src/introspect.rs lines 148 and 191 list gh.rs as the paths of the D87 and D88 decision headers, so a rename can change which decisions are selected. I did not read how paths are matched.

gh.rs is now 5,478 lines and run.rs 3,164, against 5,276 in the request. By declaration spacing, produce_and_verify is 745 lines and only four other run.rs functions exceed 180 (planning_round, dispatch, close_dispatched, land_or_block).
The next free decision number was D138.
